none.description:
{Wind Stealth}

Wind Stealth causes all allied creatures to enter stealth, making them untargetable by attacks or spells. Stealth is removed after the creature attacks and lasts for a maximum of 1 turn. Attacks made while in Stealth deal 10% increased damage.
